title: 第5342章 庞大是福星第5341章 提前布局
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：陆沉第5342章庞大是福星（..la）“没错，我们脚底下是有一个洞穴，我的人都在里面修炼。”
陆沉点点头，然后叹了一口气，又如此说道，“曙光哨所是虚神的领域，他们必须抓紧时间修炼才行，不尽快突破虚神境，无法在这里立足。”
“的确，曙光哨所禁止地神进入，违禁者格杀勿论，不是虚神还真无法在这里生存下去。”
“但你很聪明，违禁闯入，却不深入，而是在边缘地带躲着修炼，这倒是钻了魔族的一个空子。”
“魔族控制了曙光哨所入口，基本不会有地神可以闯入，搞到这边的魔族巡逻队彻底松懈了，极少对边缘地带进行巡查，这个空子正好让你给逮到了。”
韩兰说着话，突然想到了什么事，又有些不解的说道，“我没记错的话，边缘地带不但荒凉，也没有什么洞穴，你们的洞穴是怎么来的？”
“我挖的咯！”
陆沉笑道。
“神土大地，土质坚硬，并不好挖掘，挖一个洞穴得用多少时间啊？”
“更何况，你和你的人都是地神，在虚神的地方挖掘难度更大、用时更多，挖一个可以容纳五千人的大洞穴，起码得要大半年时间吧。”
“我来曙光哨所都没有几个月，你们才进来才多久，这么快就有一个大洞穴藏身修炼了？”
韩兰惊讶的看着陆沉，一脸的迷惑，又如此说道，“就算你们从闯进来就开始挖掘，估计挖到现在也挖不完，而且你们好像也没有土灵体，你们到底是怎么挖出来的？”
“我们另有特殊的手段，这就不跟你说了，反正我们能挖很快就是了。”
陆沉如此回应，却没有给出一个真实的答案。
底下的人工洞穴，不是狂热军团挖的，而是他陆沉一个人挖的，还是提前挖好的。
不然的话，怎么能够在退入曙光哨所的时侯，需要找一个藏身之处的时侯，就可以第一时间人工洞穴呢。
他不是土灵体，但他有古符文在手，他拼凑出来的各种土系符文链，效果和威力非常强大。
土灵体能够做到的事，他一样能够做到，甚至比土灵体做得更好！
但是，他拥有土灵体能力的秘密，只有最信任的人才能知道，即狂热军团全体成员。
韩兰不是狂热军团的人，他就不能把自己的秘密告诉韩兰，以免韩兰不小心泄露出去。

“还有这种手段，那真是厉害了，但你们不能泄露出去，否则会招惹麻烦。”
韩兰恍然大悟，如此说道。
“现在我军团的藏身之处已被发现，再也找不到其他藏身之所了，但修炼又不能停，他们都快突破了。”
陆沉蹙着眉头，有些担忧，又如此说道，“这次骨族大军虽然跑了，但不代表他们不会卷土重来，到时侯就不是十万大军了，可能是百万大军、千万大军，甚至是上亿大军。”
“你想多了，曙光哨所不是晨曦田园，这里的骨族可没有那么多人，一亿虚神也许有，但骨族有他们驻守的防区，不可能动用所有兵力。”
韩兰摇摇头，又如此说道，“就算是千万大军，骨族也不容易调动出来，百万大军的话……也许可以调得出来。”
“一百万个骨族虚神……”
陆沉低头看了地面一眼，嘴角勾起一道苦笑，又如此说道，“人太多了，打不了，也打不过。”
“你在魔族丘群的时侯，那可是威风八面、所向披靡，你带着五千人顶着五亿魔人打，还杀得魔族损失惨重呢。”
韩兰又说道，“怎么到了这里，才区区一百万个骨人而已，你就干不了了？”

Recommended reading for all book friends: Lu Chen Chapter 5342: Being huge is a lucky star (..la) "Yes, there is a cave under our feet, and my people are practicing in it."
Lu Chen nodded, then sighed, and said, "Dawn Outpost is the realm of the False God. They must seize the time to practice. If they don't break through the False God Realm as soon as possible, they will not be able to gain a foothold here."
"Indeed, the Dawn Outpost prohibits Earth Gods from entering. Those who violate the prohibition will be killed. If you are not a False God, you really can't survive here."
"But you are very smart. You broke in illegally, but you didn't go deep. Instead, you hid on the edge and practiced. This took advantage of the demon clan's loophole."
"The demons control the entrance to the Dawn Outpost, and basically no earth gods can break in. The demon patrols here are completely lax, and they rarely patrol the edge areas. You just caught this loophole."
As Han Lan was talking, he suddenly thought of something and said with some confusion, "If I remember correctly, the edge area is not only desolate, but also has no caves. How did your cave come from?"
"I dug it!"
Lu Chen smiled.
"The earth is a sacred land. The soil is hard and not easy to dig. How long does it take to dig a cave?"
"What's more, you and your people are the gods of the earth. It is more difficult and time-consuming to dig in the place of the virtual god. It will take at least half a year to dig a large cave that can accommodate five thousand people."
"I have only been here for a few months at Dawn Outpost, and how long have you been here? How long have you found a big cave to hide in and practice so soon?"
Han Lan looked at Lu Chen in surprise, with a confused look on his face, and then said, "Even if you started digging when you broke in, you probably wouldn't be able to finish digging until now. And you don't seem to have an earth spirit body. How did you dig it out?"
"We also have special means, which I won't tell you. Anyway, we can dig it out very quickly."
Lu Chen responded like this, but did not give a real answer.
The artificial cave underneath was not dug by the Fanatic Legion, but by Lu Chen alone, and he had dug it in advance.
Otherwise, how could we create an artificial cave immediately when we retreated to Dawn Outpost and needed to find a hiding place.
He is not an earth spirit, but he has ancient runes in his hands. The various earth rune chains he pieced together are very powerful in effect and power.
He can do what the earth spirit body can do, and he can even do it better than the earth spirit body!
However, the secret of his earth spirit ability can only be known by the most trusted people, that is, all members of the Zealot Legion.
Han Lan was not a member of the Fanatic Legion, so he could not tell Han Lan his secret, lest Han Lan accidentally leak it.
"There is also this method, which is really powerful, but you can't leak it, otherwise you will get into trouble."
Han Lan suddenly understood and said this.
"Now that my legion's hiding place has been discovered, we can no longer find another hiding place, but we can't stop practicing. They are about to break through."
Lu Chen frowned, a little worried, and said, "Although the Bone Clan army ran away this time, it does not mean that they will not come back. By then, it will not be an army of 100,000, but maybe an army of millions, tens of millions, or even hundreds of millions."
"You are overthinking. Dawn Outpost is not Dawn Garden. There are not that many Bone Clan here. There may be 100 million Void Gods, but the Bone Clan has a defense area where they are stationed. It is impossible to use all their troops."
Han Lan shook his head and said, "Even if it is an army of tens of millions, it is not easy for the Bone Clan to mobilize it. If it is an army of one million people... maybe it can be mobilized."
"One million Bone Race virtual gods..."
Lu Chen lowered his head and glanced at the ground, raised a wry smile at the corner of his mouth, and said, "There are too many people, we can't fight, and we can't beat them."
"When you were in the Demon Clan Qiuqun, that wasYou are majestic and invincible. You led five thousand people to fight against 500 million demons, and you killed the demons and suffered heavy losses. "
Han Lan added, "Why are we here, there are only one million skeletons, and you can't do it? "
